spans.s:
m. (-डन्)
A young ox, or one with six teeth.
E.
षष् six, and दत् for दन्त a tooth.

mfn. (-शः-शी-शं)
Sixteenth.
E.
शोडशन् sixteen, डट् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Sixteen, (collectively.)
E.
शोडश, and कन् added.

mfn. plu. only. (-श)
Sixteen.
E.
षष् six, and दशन् ten.

f. (-शा)
Any one of sixteen nights from the commencement of menstruation.
E.
शोडश, and ऋतु menses, निशा night.

m. (-शः)
A sixteenth.
E.
शोडश, and अंश part.

m. (-शुः)
The planet VENUS.
E.
शोडश sixteen, and अंशु a ray.

m. (-ङ्घ्रिः)
A crab.
E.
षोडश sixteen, and अङ्घ्रि a foot.

m. (-र्च्चिः)
The planet VENUS.
E.
षोडश sixteen, and अर्च्चिस् a ray.

m. (-र्त्तः)
A conch shell.
E.
षोडश sixteen, and आवर्त्त a twist or spire.

ind.
In six ways.
E.
षष six, उ substituted for the final, धा aff., and ध changed to ड.
